# JARVIS v2.3.5 Release Notes

### What's New in v2.3.5:

- **User Rules Engine:**
  Permanent user directives via voice & UI (`add_rule`, `update_rule`, `delete_rule`, `list_rules`) with automatic de-duplication, 60-rule limit, and absolute top priority prompt injection.
- **PC ⇄ Phone Remote Hub:**
  Full remote PC control (`status`, `lock`, `pc_sleep`, `shutdown`, `cancel_shutdown`, `volume_up/down`, `jarvis_wake`) with dual-protocol request-response tracking and 7 quick-action buttons in settings.
- **Phone Locator & Alarm Control:**
  Loud ringer override (`ring_phone`) to locate misplaced phone even when silent, plus instant stop (`stop_ring`).
- **Afreen Autonomous Web Architect:**
  Elite colorful UI/UX website creation running silently in background, opening previews directly in JARVIS built-in browser (`sites.afreen.local`).
- **Voice Guardian & Permissions Safety:**
  Enhanced biometric voice gating with safe tool whitelisting (`list_rules`, `get_phone_battery`, `stop_ring`) to eliminate false intruder lockouts.
- **Brand Purity & Performance Optimizations:**
  Zero memory leaks on WebSocket disconnects, coroutine cancellation safety, and 100% clean Afreen branding across all subsystems.
